responsibility: Implements the core forward jump-threading engine and path-state simplification support for tree SSA. It records temporary equivalences from PHIs and statements along candidate paths, uses callback simplifiers and optional ranger/path queries to simplify control statements across edges, manages threaded-path registration through path registries, and provides shared jt_state/jt_simplifier behavior used by both forward and backward threading strategies.
same_name_distinction: This file is the jump-thread discovery engine: it records temporary equivalences from PHIs and statements, simplifies control flow along candidate paths, manages per-path state, and drives registration of thread opportunities. In contrast, gcc/tree-ssa-threadedge.h defines the threader, simplifier, and state class interfaces those implementations use.
